title: How to make your text look futuristic (2016)
summary: A 2016 tutorial on creating futuristic-looking typography for digital designs, covering styling techniques and design principles for making text appear futuristic. The article gained significant popularity on Hacker News with 356 points.
problem_solved: How to design and style text to achieve a futuristic aesthetic in digital and web projects.
why_valuable: Provides practical design guidance for creating modern, futuristic typography that stands out in digital interfaces.
